why.role_legibility: All three use the same core mechanism (small gray labels vs bold white values for 宛先/差出人/出所), so that part is tied. D420 differs in one respect: '外部に出る' carries a diagonal arrow icon and sits on its own line under '# Slack', so it reads unambiguously as a standalone warning badge. In 14AA/F516 it is inline right after 'Slack' with only orange color (no icon) to separate it from the channel name, so at a glance it can momentarily read as part of the channel label rather than a distinct notice.
why.visual_craft: Layout, spacing of the field rows, body paragraph, source line and button row are identical across all three. The only craft-relevant difference is the header: D420 gives the external-share notice its own line plus an icon, which resolves it as a deliberate UI element; 14AA/F516 rely on color alone packed into the header line, which is more compact but reads as a slightly less finished treatment of an important warning.
why.information_hierarchy: The bold question title dominates in all three regardless of header treatment, so the primary/secondary/tertiary read (title > fields > body > source) is equally clear after 3 seconds in every variant.
why.preview_readability: Body text ('明日の会議、資料を先に共有します。10 月の導入時期の件も入れておきました。') has identical size, weight, color and line spacing in all three — no readability difference.
why.provenance_visibility: The 出所 row (週次同期・田中・10:42 with chevron) is styled and positioned identically relative to the body text and the button row in all three cards — no difference in whether it competes with the body.
why.screen_occupation: D420 is taller because '外部に出る' occupies its own line below '# Slack'; 14AA and F516 fold it into the header line, making the card shorter for the same content. 14AA and F516 are equal in height.
why.overall: 14AA and F516 are the more space-efficient, compact version of the same card and are visually indistinguishable from each other in every axis checked. D420 trades a little extra vertical space for a clearer, icon-marked external-share warning. Overall the compact pair edges out on efficiency, with D420 close behind on warning clarity.

differences: D420 shows '外部に出る' with a diagonal arrow icon (↗) on its own line beneath the '# Slack' header, making that header block two lines tall.
14AA and F516 instead place '外部に出る' inline on the same line as '# Slack' (no arrow icon), which is more compact — their cards are shorter overall than D420's.

No other differences were detected: the question title, 宛先/差出人 rows, body paragraph, 出所 row, divider, and Cancel/Edit/送る button row are the same layout, weight, color and spacing across all three images.
14AA and F516 appear pixel-for-pixel identical to each other in every respect I could discern; I could not find any distinguishing feature between them.
